create_incremental_date_list: create a list of n datetimes with given increments in years, months, or days from a start date
convert_millis_to_datetime: convert a Unix millisecond timestamp into a timezone-aware UTC datetime object
parse_date_string: parse a date string into a timezone-aware datetime object using a specified format
compute_date_ranges: compute a list of date ranges with corresponding durations in months and days from a start date
calculate_outer_date_range: calculate the outer date range from an Earth Engine FeatureCollection of date ranges
